purpose: Fail-closed real portfolio-risk evidence gate using real prospective paper evidence, ex-ante exposure decisions, conservative correlation calibration, tail stress, bankroll trace, and kill-switch drills.
required_inputs: one or more real C02 R3 PASS evidence references covering every risk-decision sport/market
kill_switch_drills for drawdown, daily loss, data, model, execution and provider incidents
closure_rule: Synthetic PASS validates the auditor only. H-02 remains OPEN until real paper-derived portfolio decisions, real bankroll trace, calibrated correlations, stress results and all kill-switch drills pass independently.
